name: Verdant Outpost
description: A lush, sun-drenched outpost surrounded by rolling green hills, wild flowers, and gentle wildlife. The perfect staging ground for novice adventurers.
visualTheme: Sun-drenched wooden stockade perched on a grassy ridge, overlooking rolling pastures of wild clover.

history.createdWhy: Established as a logging colony and scouting outpost to monitor forest movements.
history.builtWho: Constructed by Eldorian royal engineers during the expansion era.
history.majorEvents: Survived three seasonal goblin siege attempts, defending the eastern frontier.
history.whyExists: Acts as a vital supplier of timber and herbs to the inner kingdom.
history.currentConflicts: The nearby goblin clans have cut off trade caravans to the capital.

ecosystem.weather: Bright sunshine with a gentle breeze

npcs.name: Guard Captain Vaelen
dialogue: Stay vigilant. Goblins are raiding further from the woods.
If you are going into the forest, make sure you are armed.
The King's troops are delayed. We are on our own.

secrets.name: Hidden Stockpile
secrets.description: A cache of forgotten supply crates hidden behind the watchtower.
